skills.name: repository-maintainer
skills.description: Monitors and maintains the antigravity-skills repository by validating skill structures, detecting rule violations, reviewing documentation quality, and proposing releases. Activates when the user asks to review, audit, or improve the skills registry.
skills.author: Fábio Ferreccio

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Guides the user through designing, scaffolding, documenting, and validating new Antigravity Skills. Activates when the user wants to create a new skill, teach the agent a new capability, or automate a specialized workflow.
skills.author: Fábio Ferreccio
